meta.name: hunt-api-misconfig
meta.description: Hunt API security misconfiguration — mass assignment, JWT attacks, prototype pollution, HTTP verb tampering. Mass assignment: send {is_admin:true, role:admin, verified:true} on profile/account/reset endpoints — server blindly applies. JWT: alg=none, weak HMAC bruteforce, kid path traversal, JWK injection, token confusion. Prototype pollution: __proto__ injection in JSON merge / Object.assign / lodash _.merge → polluted prototype reaches sink (RCE in Node, XSS in browser). HTTP verb: GET-bypass-CSRF, X-HTTP-Method-Override, TRACE enabled. Detection: API responses with extra fields, JWTs in headers (decode at jwt.io). CORS misconfiguration (reflect-any-origin, null origin, subdomain-regex bypass, postMessage) is owned by hunt-cors. Use when hunting API misconfigs, JWT flaws, mass-assignment, prototype pollution.

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you detect API security misconfigurations including mass assignment, JWT attacks, prototype pollution, HTTP verb tampering, OData injection, and Swagger exposure, providing exploitation methods and detection steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to test API security configurations, or when you find suspicious JWT, mass assignment, prototype pollution, OData endpoints, or Swagger docs.

say_en.text: Test this API for mass assignment vulnerability.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to send requests with fields like is_admin:true.

say_en.text: Check if this JWT uses the none algorithm.
say_en.note: Claude will teach you to decode and verify the JWT signature.

say_en.text: Scan this OData endpoint for injection vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Claude will provide test methods like $filter and $batch.
